description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kalastria Highborn, adding {B}.
When Kalastria Highborn dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Kalastria Highborn trigger, causing you to pay {B} to have an opponent lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Kalastria Highborn from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Kalastria Highborn from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.
